name: Ex-BombRat
text: You were once a member of the BombRats (3rd Aerial Demolitions Unit or later sky pirates) and know how they operate. +2 on the Dexterity roll to dodge when caught in one of their explosives.

name: BombRat
text: You're a BombRat: slightly deranged, feared for your explosives, uncivilized. BombRats are typically only civil to each other; you can talk with them.

name: Survived the BombRats
text: You had a run-in with the BombRats and survived. +4 on Cunning rolls to notice whether a ship or person is a BombRat.
